TEXT:
[FI] I started thinking about the past as I was walking 
home.

[FI] I had heard the story of the Makishima sisters from 
Saori.
[FI] Makishima Kaori.

[FI] According to Saori, she's a problematic person who 
acts on her own, is irrational, and never listens to 
anyone.

[FI] She has so many interests and talents, she was said 
to be so good at everything it pisses you off, or so 
she said.
[FI] Always full of confidence, lively, and cool...
[FI] Having met her, I can agree to that assessment.
[FI] She lives up to her description.

[FI] From outdoor to indoor activities, she is able to do 
so many different things.

[FI] She always gives it her all in every aspect of her 
life.

[FI] Only moving forward, she doesn't look back on 
those left behind.
[FI] Being that kind of person, why would she...

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] I came to intrude on you guys.
[FI] ...say something like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You can't just decide how a person should act.
[FI] You can't just understand people like that.
[FI] Even I'm not exactly sure what kind of person I am.

[FI] "I couldn't care less about that little sister of mine. I 
really think that from the bottom of my heart."
[FI] "Kirino... Leave it to me."

[FI] Saying one thing and doing another, as well as 
being irrational is pretty common.

[FI] ...She is a lot more amazing than me, and the way I 
live is completely opposite to hers.
[FI] I wonder why.
[FI] But what is this feeling whirling up in my chest?

[FI] Could this be naturally not liking someone because 
they're similar?

[FI] While thinking and walking back to my house, it 
became dark at some point.

[FI] Right in front of my house, I stopped, and at that 
moment...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] !
[FI] Suddenly, a bright light blinded my vision.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What...

[FI] Squinting my eyes, I can see the silhouette of a 
motorcycle, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wai- huh... you're joking, right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Gyaaaaaa!!!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: [FI] Hey, hey, cut it out with those misleading screams.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] If you scream like that, it'll seem like I hit you with 
my bike and kidnapped you deep into the night.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I wouldn't do such a horrible thing to my little 
sister's boyfriend, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I am a bit of a mischief-maker, so I stopped my 
bike right before I hit you, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] You scare easily and entered a state of shock, so I 
would kindly take you to the hospital out of pity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well, some sort of touching scene like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] What, no need to thank me. I only did what was 
expected of me.
[FI] ...What's with that extremely unnatural excuse...!

[FI] Having mustered my strength to retort, I let go of 
my consciousness.
